finalText:
**Big: 1082 occurrences across 94 files**, but most is mechanical (repo/service/route layers use `account_id` as a plain parameter name in ~80 app files, all safely renameable).

Four places must stay `account_id`:

| Location | Reason |
|---|---|
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | public API contract, field explicitly marked "Frozen field name" |
| `lib/serialize.js` | wire-format map, comment says internal rename "must not reach this side of the map" |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/**` | generated/vendored, "Do not edit" |
| `migrations/*.sql` | already applied in prod; editing history breaks the down-step, not the column |

`lib/audit.js` also carries `account_id` in log lines — worth confirming with platform team whether audit logs are consumed externally before touching it.

Not safe to sign off as a pure find-and-replace: the DB column and public API field are load-bearing and out of scope. A real rename needs a new migration adding `owner_id`, app code updated to read/write both, then backfill and drop `account_id` later — plus a versioned API change for the OpenAPI contract.
